name: vscode-strata
description: Shows the live status of a Strata inference engine metrics endpoint in the VS Code status bar.

strata.enabled.description: Show the Strata status bar item and poll the metrics endpoint.

strata.endpoint.description: URL of the Strata JSON metrics endpoint.

strata.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often the metrics endpoint is polled.

strata.apiKey.markdownDescription: Fallback API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, for servers started with a key (`--new-key`, `--api-key-env NAME`). Prefer the `Strata: Set API Key` command, which stores the key in VS Code's encrypted secret storage instead of settings.json.

strata.statusBar.priority.markdownDescription: Ordering among status bar items (higher renders further left). Built-in right-side editor items (Ln/Col, indent, encoding, EOL, language) sit at 100–100.5, so the default 105 places Strata in front of them on the right side. The icon item uses priority + 1.

strata.statusBar.splitIcon.markdownDescription: Show the state icon as its own small status bar item in front of the text. This keeps the `$(sync~spin)` animation running uninterrupted by value updates. When `false` (default), the icon is merged into the text (added automatically, or via the `${icon}` placeholder), so the spin restarts on each text update.

strata.statusBar.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar the item sits on.

strata.statusBar.activeStyle.markdownDescription: How the item highlights while the engine is not idle: `color` = item text/icon in `strata.statusBar.activeColor`, `warning` = yellow background, `spin` = spinning icon only. Note: VS Code only allows error/warning backgrounds on status items — custom per-item background colors are rejected by the API.

strata.statusBar.activeColor.markdownDescription: CSS color used for the item's text/icon while the engine is not idle (used with `activeStyle: color`). Set to an empty string to disable.

strata.statusBar.format.markdownDescription: Template for the status bar text. Placeholders: `${state}`, `${phase}`, `${gen}` (decode now, t/s), `${gen_avg}` (average generation speed of this/last request, t/s), `${pre}` (prefill t/s), `${gpu}`, `${vram}`, `${power}`, `${temp}`, `${cpu}`, `${ram}`, `${ctx}`, `${ctxmax}`, `${queued}`, `${running}`, `${model}`, `${hit}` (cache hit rate), `${acc}` (draft acceptance), `${icon}` (state-driven codicon; with `splitIcon: false` it is also prepended automatically if the format has no codicon). Segments separated by `|` whose placeholders have no value are hidden automatically. Any codicon works too, e.g. `$(vm-active)`, `$(device-chip)`, `$(server)`, `$(rocket)`.
